name: devbook
description: The devbook convention: .arc42, .domain, .tech, .design, and .ai knowledge folders of addressed Markdown chapters, each carrying a parseable meta block with status ladders, a shared approved rung, runnable test-case links, and an opaque ext namespace a layered plugin keeps its own state in, compiled into derived _meta indexes and a reference-graph canvas. Ships per-folder orchestration skills, bidirectional to-spec-<kind> and from-spec-<kind> converters between chapters and code, a versioned contract with runnable migrations, and enforcement tooling.
